header.policy: Retain selected snapshots and currently linked images; no recovery refs or historical commits may be purged on the strength of this catalog. Capture revision remains unverified unless producer metadata establishes it.

schema.scope: header plus leading complete entries; catalog remainder and final limitations outside assignment

contract.producer: Reviewed historical selection and archive publication/verification receipts, inventory dated 2026-10-19.
contract.consumer: Evidence-storage documentation and human recovery/migration review; no direct runtime consumer located in scoped text search.
policies: Retain dedicated selected report/captures, excluding inherited unrelated files.
Never purge historical commits or recovery refs on catalog strength.
Stored source commit and checksums establish byte origin, not rendered revision.
Publication requires checksum/Git identity and gallery inspection evidence before links are replaced.
Representative decoding and loaded image counts are separate from complete media-reference audits.
contract.validity: Catalog reports historical downloads and inspections; remote existence, checksums and capture revision not revalidated.
contract.cleanup: Retain provenance, checksums and recovery history; no deletion authorized.
contract.limits: Some inspected pages load fewer images than imageElements; only explicit media-reference counts support full reference coverage.

verificationLimits: No tests, browser, network, generator, runtime, staging or commit executed.
No runtime symbol navigation required: assigned files are JSON registries; supporting references inspected as text.
Remote publication/download/inspection receipts are historical assertions, not revalidated this session.
